title: Downloads
rendererComingSoon: This feature is still in development and is not available to download yet.

description.center: Install the components needed for camera recording and rendering.
description.renderer: A mod that turns recorded runs into videos.
description.ffmpeg: Video encoding for Windows camera recording. OrbitRender manages its own FFmpeg setup.

consent.renderer: With your consent, TUFReplay downloads the official OrbitRender release from GitHub and installs this separately licensed GPL mod into the game's Mods folder.
consent.ffmpeg: With your consent, TUFReplay downloads and verifies FFmpeg for camera recording. The build may include GPL components. It is stored in TUFReplay’s folder.

restartHelp: Fully quit and reopen ADOFAI, then enable OrbitRender in Unity Mod Manager.

errors.statusFailed: Installation status could not be read. Check that the game is running with the latest TUFReplay enabled, then try again.
errors.downloads_unavailable: Update TUFReplay and fully restart ADOFAI to use the download center.
errors.actionFailed: The installation request could not be sent. Check your connection to the game, then try again.
errors.renderer_download_timeout: The Renderer download timed out. Check your connection and try again.
errors.installFailed: Installation could not finish. Check the details, available disk space and your connection, then try again.
errors.renderer_release_unavailable: The official OrbitRender release has not been published yet. Try again after a release is available.
errors.renderer_release_inaccessible: The Renderer repository could not be accessed. It may be private or unavailable. Try again once a public release is available.
errors.renderer_release_invalid: The published Renderer package or verification file is incomplete. Try again after the release is corrected.
errors.renderer_checksum_mismatch: The Renderer download did not match the published file. Try downloading it again.
errors.renderer_directory_exists: A Renderer folder already exists. Restart the game and check the installed mod. Move an incomplete installation aside before trying again.

setup.label: Steps to make videos
setup.forRender: You need OrbitRender to make videos. Follow these steps.

install.title: Install OrbitRender
install.about: Downloads the official release from GitHub into ADOFAI's Mods folder.
install.update: Version 2.6.2 or later is needed. This one is {{version}}.

restart.title: Restart ADOFAI
restart.about: Once it's installed, quit ADOFAI completely and open it again.
restart.now: Quit ADOFAI completely and open it again to turn OrbitRender on.
restart.stuck: Still on this step after restarting? Turn OrbitRender on in Unity Mod Manager.

create.title: Make a video
create.ready: You're all set. Choose “{{action}}” from a run's menu.
